featureSummary.title: Feature summary
featureSummary.description: What’s new beyond the Cursor baseline. The two original reports stay as the PM reference; the new work lives in Storage Health & Capacity Outlook and in AI-assisted editing.

items.name: KPI sparkline + change
items.desc: Each summary card shows a 30-day trend line and a ▲▼ change vs 30 days ago, colored green or red by whether that direction is good.
items.demo: Point at Avg latency (down = green) vs Critical arrays (up = red).

items.name: Capacity gauge
items.desc: Semicircle gauge of used vs raw capacity with warning (75%) and critical (90%) ticks. Fill turns orange or red past each one.
items.demo: Fleet capacity utilization card.

items.name: Donut with total
items.desc: Pie variant with the total in the center. Same hover, labels and toggleable legend as the original pie.
items.demo: Used capacity by data center.

items.name: Stacked status bar
items.desc: Counts split into OK / Warning / Critical with alert chart colors. Legend shows counts and toggles each status.
items.demo: Array health by data center — toggle Warning off.

items.name: Bullet bars
items.desc: Top-N values against warning and critical bands, so “how close to the limit” reads at a glance.
items.demo: Most constrained arrays.

items.name: Area chart
items.desc: Line chart with a filled area for growth stories.
items.demo: Fleet used capacity.

items.name: Card sizing
items.desc: Cards span 1, 2 or full width. Spans shrink automatically when the drawer narrows the canvas.
items.demo: Ask the assistant: “Make the capacity trend full width.”

items.name: Table sparklines
items.desc: 14-day trend drawn inside each table row.
items.demo: IOPS, 14 days column.

items.name: Threshold & status pills
items.desc: Cells turn yellow or red past their limits (Used %, Latency, Days to full) plus a Status pill column.
items.demo: Scan the table’s Used and Days to full columns.

items.name: Click to filter
items.desc: Click a donut slice, stacked segment or bullet row to filter the whole report to that value. One filter at a time; click again to clear.
items.demo: Click San Jose in the donut.

items.name: Context stays visible
items.desc: The clicked chart keeps all its data with the selection highlighted and the rest dimmed.
items.demo: Watch the donut after clicking.

items.name: Honest history
items.desc: History-based charts and KPI trends are not filtered; they’re marked “Not filtered · fleet history” or hidden.
items.demo: Point at the Fleet used capacity pill.

items.name: Filter bar
items.desc: “Filtered by [Field: value ×]” and Clear filter under the header. View-only — never counted as an edit.
items.demo: Clear the filter from the bar.

items.name: Right-docked drawer
items.desc: Edit opens the AI assistant as a push drawer on the right, next to the Edit button, so the report stays in view. Deliberate deviation from Cursor’s left drawer.
items.demo: Click Edit; note the blue edge pulse.

items.name: Scripted prompts
items.desc: Predictable suggested prompts per report with typed-out replies. Each applies a real change to the report.
items.demo: Run any suggested prompt.

items.name: Highlight what changed
items.desc: Only cards whose output changed flash, then keep a blue border and a “Modified” tag until Save or Cancel.
items.demo: “Only show critical arrays” — note which cards light up.

items.name: Unsaved changes list
items.desc: “N unsaved changes ▾” in the header lists every change; click one to jump to its card.
items.demo: Open the list after two prompts.

items.name: Undo per change
items.desc: Each change in the transcript has its own Undo; other changes stay.
items.demo: Undo the first of two changes.

items.name: Show original
items.desc: Switch between the saved report and your draft without losing anything.
items.demo: Toggle Show original in the header.

items.name: Save with summary
items.desc: Save report dialog lists every change, then lets you rename and describe the report.
items.demo: Click Save.

items.name: Discard guard
items.desc: Leaving with unsaved changes asks “Discard changes?” first.
items.demo: Press Esc with changes pending.
